status_reason: adapter implemented (wav2sleep.ppg-only.v1, shadow-only, disabled by default) and bit-identical to the official code on synthetic fixtures at 24 and 25 Hz with max_length_hours equal to the run length (max abs probability diff 0, argmax 100%; against the official 10-h default padding only 395/960 and 398/960 agree, deviation D1); blocked because no anchored, contiguous overnight PPG reaches the server (Spec 01 transport not landed, no overnight raw-optical capture) and there is no WHOOP sleep-stage evaluation set
input_contract: PPG only: input.ppg.segments[] absolute ADC counts at a declared native rate of 25 Hz (anchored v26) or 24 Hz, with the Spec 01 members run_id, config.identity, config.known=true, config.stable=true and clock.packet_timing_verified=true with clock.samples_per_second equal to ppg.native_rate_hz; segments joined only within one run_id and only when contiguous; each run is one recording resampled to the pinned 1024-per-30-s grid (34.133 Hz, linear interpolation, no padding) and z-scored over the run; ECG/ABD/THX absent; PPG-derived respiration/RSA refused as ABD/THX; window <= 10 h (1200 epochs), >= 4 h scored from runs >= 2 h, >= 75% coverage; output: per-30-s epoch softmax probabilities + logits (wake/light/deep/rem) with mask, mask reason and native-sample provenance, argmax label as a separate field
